qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Decades-built renewable development pipeline and procurement scale combined with Florida Power & Light's low-bill, high-reliability regulated monopoly service territory.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet). NextEra is a premier clean energy utility combining FPL's constructive Florida regulatory compact with NEER's renewable scale (CAP 20). However, funding this continuous capital expansion requires immense balance sheet leverage ($89.6B LT debt vs $6.8B net income, 13.1x ratio) and interest coverage is compressed (~2.0x-2.4x), failing the peace-of-mind balance sheet test and relying perpetually on external capital markets.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year GAAP ROIC median of 4.99% (2025: 4.99%, 2024: 6.21%, 2022: 3.83%, 2021: 3.15%). LT debt of $89.56B against net income of $6.84B yields 13.1x leverage (far above 4.0x ceiling). FY2025 interest coverage is ~2.0x-2.4x (below 5.0x hurdle). Multi-billion annual capital expenditure program relies on continuous access to debt, equity, and tax-equity markets (kindness of strangers).

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
